mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT n.id,n.type,n.content,n.is_read,n.create_time,n.actor_id,u.nick_name actor_nick_name,u.avatar actor_avatar,n.article_id,a.title article_title,n.comment_id,n.root_comment_id FROM yan_user_notification n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=n.actor_id AND u.del_flag=0 LEFT JOIN yan_article a ON a.id=n.article_id AND a.del_flag=0 WHERE n.receiver_id=#{receiverId} UNION ALL SELECT -e.id,'ARTICLE_PUBLISHED',NULL,1,e.create_time,e.author_id,u.nick_name,u.avatar,e.article_id,a.title,NULL,NULL FROM yan_author_publish_event e INNER JOIN yan_user_follow f ON f.followee_id=e.author_id AND f.follower_id=#{receiverId} INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.author_id AND u.del_flag=0 INNER JOIN yan_article a ON a.id=e.article_id AND a.del_flag=0) inbox ORDER BY is_read ASC,create_time DESC,id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM yan_user_notification WHERE receiver_id=#{receiverId} AND is_read=0
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_user_notification SET is_read=1,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND receiver_id=#{receiverId} AND is_read=0
UPDATE yan_user_notification SET is_read=1,update_time=NOW() WHERE receiver_id=#{receiverId} AND is_read=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM yan_user_notification WHERE id=#{id} AND receiver_id=#{receiverId}
